interpretations.I1: Accepted (Edith r7): item 11's three-way reading 'outside the Holm family' is a family of one, bootstrap.holm_one_sided({test: p}) declaring it iff p <= 0.025, then bootstrap.three_way at margin -10; labelled 'unadjusted (exploratory, outside Holm)'.
interpretations.I2: Accepted (Edith r7): item 14 T+/G- is the driver's fairness family (fairness.fairness_indices over Haiku-, Opus- and Sonnet-medium, comparison Opus, local_steps view) with each step's class relabelled T+ / G- / other by its kind; flag K in that output is reported, never used as a flag.
interpretations.I3: Replaced (Edith r7; C1 item 16): 'missing' is a planned try with no final record, the converter's kind 'missing' only (it matches the driver's missing_left_out). Final records of kind empty, unexpected_stop or error are real results: wrong, reported as their own kinds in the rates (count / designed calls), and kept by the exclude-missing view. E3: only an unfinished chain is missing.
interpretations.I4: Accepted (Edith r7): item 16 retries: every real-time error record with HTTP status 429 or 5xx is counted (by status group), with how many of them were followed by another attempt of the same custom_id; Batch resubmits are later `batch_submitting` records that hold an errored / expired / canceled custom_id again.
interpretations.I5: Accepted (Edith r7; C2): item 24's pooled Haiku median is the median over all 2 x bases puzzle values (both shapes), as curve._panels defines the pooled median.
interpretations.I6: Accepted (Edith r7; C2): an arm's accuracy is the mean over base puzzles of scoring.arm_scores (points); a Haiku arm's chart point uses its single-try cost (9b at k = 1); its own k uses the arm's mean list cost per call against the comparator's mean per puzzle of its calls' list cost, as kscript.k_table defines both.
interpretations.I7: Accepted (Edith r7; C2): item 8's per-k curve diagnostics are the method counts, the largest mc_se and the mean tie-decided share over base puzzles (report_votes.curve_summary).
interpretations.I8: Accepted (Edith r7; C2): item 14: a try that did not answer (refusal, truncated, missing, ...) counts as unplaceable with its kind as the reason, as the driver's fairness input does (main_analysis._tries_for_fairness).
